# pve_ceph_osd_out (Action)

Mark one OSD out (ceph osd out).

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_ceph_osd_out" "example" {
  config {
  node = "pve1"
  osdid = 1
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_ceph_osd_out.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `osdid` (Number) OSD ID
